exceptions.evidence: No hard source; same backbone substitutes radius into fixed equations. Larger/rational coefficients do not add solution stages; phase, center, arbitrary start and speed changes are source-absent operations.

finite_domain_policy.easy: positive exact rational <=30, denominator <=5, reject complete-bank collisions
finite_domain_policy.moderate: positive integer radius <=30; default sampling 2..30; reject complete-bank collisions

variants_counted_by: radius and mathematical supplied/requested role; no seed, bank, identity or order aliases
